alt: Scotland players in dark navy jerseys clustered at the touchline taking water bottles during an official hydration break in their 2026 World Cup match against Morocco
story: FIFA introduced mandatory three-minute 'hydration breaks' in all 2026 World Cup matches, insisting they're for player welfare — but they stop play even in 19°C/66°F rainy Toronto, air-conditioned Dallas, and indoor Atlanta, while Fox Sports airs full-screen commercials during every pause.
why_funny: FIFA designed a player-welfare break that triggers in cold, wet, air-conditioned stadiums where the only thing being refreshed is Fox's $200,000-per-slot ad revenue — and every fan in every stadium boos it.
